body.p: Dyooa. Dyooa went to the forest after that. In front of him, on a river bank, a little tent is seen. Dyooa said: "It would be good for me to go to the tent". Dyooa reached the tent. Dyooa hid near the tent. After a while, an old woman went outside and urinated. Dyooa grabbed the old woman by her hand. The old woman almost screamed. Dyooa said: "Shh, shh, he said, give your old man a shout like that." The old woman cried: "Come here, my child is born." The old man jumped outside saying: "Where, where, old woman?" Dyooa is crying like a little child: "Wah, wah." The old man says: "It turns out to be a boy, it would be good for me to raise him." The old woman and the old man entered the tent. Dyooa after some time became a boy, he walks outside. And the old man had a big male reindeer. The old man fishes, the old woman dries the fish. After a while, Dyooa said: "Dad, it would be good for us to kill the big male reindeer." The old man doesn't want to. The old woman said: "Why don't you want to?" You refuse your only child. After a while, the old man killed the big reindeer. There is lots of meat. Dyooa said: "Daddy, we should move away from this place.". Dyooa said" "I'll take the meat of the big reindeer away. Put the dried fish into the boat too, I will go to the other side of the river. I'll come to take you both." Dyooa swam on the water, he rows to the other side of the river. Dyooa reached the middle of the river, Dyooa cried: "Old man, old woman, I was not your child, I am Dyooa." Dyooa has gone down the river forever. The old woman and the old man died of hunger. Dyooa is like that.
